children: Impact Biomedical announced a 1-for-12.62 reverse stock split effective Sept. 23, 2026 to support its proposed merger with Zoar Limited and NYSE American continued-listing objectives.
Board approved a 1-for-12.62 reverse stock split effective 12:01 a.m. ET on Sept. 23, 2026 to consolidate outstanding shares.
Outstanding shares will fall from ~107.8M to ~8.54M; fractional shares will be rounded up to whole shares.
Proportional adjustments to equity awards, exercise/conversion prices, and shares reserved under incentive plans.
Reverse split is intended to aid completing the merger with Zoar and help regain NYSE American listing compliance, but offers no assurance.
Upon closing of the proposed merger, Impact stockholders are expected to receive one share of Zoar for each one share of Impact after the reverse split.
